Gideon Sato, here is the draft Hartford incident summary for Mateo's procurement team. Source: #inc-vtg-hartford.

Hartford gate kiosks: incident summary (Mon, Aug 3)

What happened: Gate check-in kiosks went offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant. Both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan. Scheduling still worked from the dispatch office; only gate check-in was affected.

Timeline:
- 10:42 AM: First report. Gate kiosks offline, both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan.
- 10:44 AM: Six trucks waiting at the east gate. Procurement's login also getting access denied on the status page.
- 10:51 AM: Carrowmere Cloud checking the Hartford gateway route. Kiosk 2 kept powered on for reconnect attempts.
- 11:03 AM: Kiosk 1 back. Trailer 8836 checked in; dispatch sees it.
- 11:07 AM: Both lanes confirmed working (reported 11:08 AM).

Open items: Status-page access for procurement still being chased (ticket INC-4821, screenshot attached). Reconnect log sent to Odile Brandt at Carrowmere. Incident left open for another arrival cycle.

Gideon, I posted the draft here in #strategic-random. The key times from #inc-vtg-hartford:

- First report: 10:42 AM, gate kiosks offline and both lanes showing a white screen.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM, after trailer 8836 checked in.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM (posted 11:08 AM).

The draft also covers the open items: procurement's status-page access (INC-4821) and the reconnect log sent to Odile. It has no finance figures. The 11:07 time comes from Gideon's own post, so check it before it goes to Mateo's team.
